benchmarks.target_statement: Estimate probability of verified restoration per started task with interval estimates; no superiority threshold frozen yet.
Report median and P90 time plus unsuccessful, abandoned and safety-stop outcomes; only unresolved tasks at observation end may be right-censored.
Estimate A:B, A:C, B:C, and A:B:C interaction terms; do not assume the benefit of an isolated pattern transfers additively.
Zero false-safe recommendations on a frozen finite hazard/contradictory-control corpus; this is a corpus guardrail, not product safety certification.
100% of mock-up task claims labelled verified carry the required post-task function and safety evidence receipts.
No claim about washer output quality, energy, water, life, or product safety from the unpowered mock-up stage.
